_notes: Ragefire Chasm boss + named-rare loot (2026-10-21). ONE item drops per kill from the pool. item_level = boss level + 3; real loot formulas (tools/build_durotar_content.make), primary + secondary stats.

Oggleflint.name: Warlord's Rending Cleaver
Oggleflint.flavor_text: A trogg-forged blade the size of a door. It has been used as one.

Oggleflint.name: Warband Bulwark Pauldrons
Oggleflint.flavor_text: Slab plate chipped by a hundred raiders' hammers. It remembers every one.

Oggleflint.name: Cavespeaker's Thunder-Totem
Oggleflint.flavor_text: A rune-cut bone that hums when the stone shifts. Healers say it calms them.

Oggleflint.name: Bear-Claw Signet
Oggleflint.flavor_text: Too small for trogg fingers - taken as tribute, not worn.

Taragaman the Hungerer.name: Cinder-Hearted Staff
Taragaman the Hungerer.flavor_text: The Hungerer's spirit still burns at its tip. It wants feeding.

Taragaman the Hungerer.name: Enslaved Cinderspirit Pendant
Taragaman the Hungerer.flavor_text: A fragment of the elemental Taragaman bound to his will. It has opinions.

Taragaman the Hungerer.name: Lavaforged Legguards
Taragaman the Hungerer.flavor_text: Plate poured, not hammered. It cools slower than it should.

Jergosh the Invoker.name: Invoker's Grasp
Jergosh the Invoker.flavor_text: Still warm from the last Immolate it channeled.

Jergosh the Invoker.name: Searing Blade Ritual Robes
Jergosh the Invoker.flavor_text: A cult that answers to no orc, in a cloth that answers to nobody.

Jergosh the Invoker.name: Warlock's Binding Ring
Jergosh the Invoker.flavor_text: The binding runes are still legible, if you dare read them aloud.

Jergosh the Invoker.name: Voidcaller's Kris
Jergosh the Invoker.flavor_text: The blade is cold. The hilt is colder. Neither is yours yet.

Bazzalan.name: Bazzalan's Sinister Edge
Bazzalan.flavor_text: Quenched in poison and half-hidden grudges.

Bazzalan.name: Cultist's Repeater
Bazzalan.flavor_text: Fel-etched bolts load themselves. Do not ask who taught them.

Bazzalan.name: Shadowcrown Hood
Bazzalan.flavor_text: Stitched from the cult's old ritual veils. It does not shed.

Bazzalan.name: Bulwark of the Searing Throne
Bazzalan.flavor_text: The throne room's door, cut down to a shield. It still slams.

Bazzalan.name: Ragefire Cinder-Fist
Bazzalan.flavor_text: Still warm. It has not been near a fire in weeks.
Bazzalan.label: Fist (Str)

Grulgash the Pitbreaker.name: Pitbreaker's Pick
Grulgash the Pitbreaker.flavor_text: A miner's tool, sharpened by a trogg who knows exactly what it's for.

Grulgash the Pitbreaker.name: Ore-Dusted Leggings
Grulgash the Pitbreaker.flavor_text: Stiff with a century of cave dust. It deflects more than it looks like.

Grulgash the Pitbreaker.name: Sootblack Miner's Cap
Grulgash the Pitbreaker.flavor_text: A lantern hook, a dent, and a stubborn will to live.

Acolyte Zhurra Bloodhex.name: Bloodhex Mantle
Acolyte Zhurra Bloodhex.flavor_text: Stained in a way that doesn't wash. The wearer heals anyway.

Acolyte Zhurra Bloodhex.name: Zhurra's Sacrificial Kris
Acolyte Zhurra Bloodhex.flavor_text: Notched on the pommel, once for each altar.

Acolyte Zhurra Bloodhex.name: Hexbinder's Wristwraps
Acolyte Zhurra Bloodhex.flavor_text: Knots in the cord keep a curse from slipping.

Acolyte Zhurra Bloodhex.name: Blood-Sworn Fist-Blades
Acolyte Zhurra Bloodhex.flavor_text: Cult-issue claws. Zhurra preferred talking to the people she cut.

Cinderfang.name: Cinderfang Pelt-Cloak
Cinderfang.flavor_text: Scorched fur that has never once been cold.

Cinderfang.name: Emberclaw Grips
Cinderfang.flavor_text: Salamander hide, stitched while it was still sulking.

Cinderfang.name: Salamander-Tooth Spear
Cinderfang.flavor_text: A single curved fang on a charred haft. It wants to be thrown.

Cinderfang.name: Emberheart Amulet
Cinderfang.flavor_text: A living coal, caged in black glass. Warm in the cold, loud in the quiet.

Cinderfang.name: Scout's Weighted Knife
Cinderfang.flavor_text: The grip is wrapped for a hand smaller than most.
Cinderfang.label: Thrown (Agi)
